procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
summary: Single-day permission to serve alcoholic beverages at private parties, banquets, and commercial corporate events.
estimated_total_cost: ₹2,500 – ₹10,000 per day based on venue capacity

steps.title: Book approved banquet or private venue
steps.description: Confirm venue reservation and acquire venue owner's letter of permission.

steps.title: Submit online permit application
steps.description: Enter event host details, guest count estimate, event date/hours, and liquor source retailer name.

steps.title: Pay permit duty online
steps.description: Remit daily event excise duty through state integrated financial management portal.

steps.title: Procure liquor from authorized retailer
steps.description: Purchase beverages exclusively from authorized state vends accompanied by serial-numbered invoices.

steps.title: Display permit at bar counter
steps.description: Keep physical/digital copy of issued excise permit at the serving bar during the entire event.
